results.controlIntent: a. Identify system flaws; report system flaws; and correct system flaws; b. Test, for effectiveness, software and firmware updates related to flaw remediation before installation; and test, for potential side effects, those updates before installation; c. Install security-relevant software and firmware updates within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of the release of the updates; and d. Fold flaw remediation into the organizational configuration management process.

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals multiple SI-2.r4 violations:

**SI-2.r4(a) — Identify, report, and correct flaws:** No evidence of a documented flaw identification or reporting process was found in either CloudTrail or the model registry.

**SI-2.r4(b) — Test updates before installation:** No pre-deployment testing records or staging approvals are present in any retrieved evidence for either the initial deployment or the hotfix.

**SI-2.r4(c) — Install updates within defined time period:** No organization-defined time-period SLA for update installation is evidenced. The hotfix (abbe1f2d, 2026-03-15) was applied without any registry tracking, making SLA compliance unverifiable.

**SI-2.r4(d) — Fold flaw remediation into configuration management:** This is the most clearly violated sub-requirement. The UpdateEndpoint event (abbe1f2d) on 2026-03-15 deployed a hotfix config ("churn-predictor-v1-hotfix") with no corresponding model registry entry — meaning the change bypassed the established configuration management process entirely. Additionally, the CreateEndpoint event (c1fa6b69) carries a note flagging a change-control anomaly relative to the registry approval timestamp (adef3124, approved 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z vs. deployment at 11:00:00Z), suggesting the deployment sequence may not have followed the approved change-control gate.

In summary: the hotfix deployment with no registry entry is a direct, evidence-backed violation of SI-2.r4(d), and the absence of testing records and SLA definitions means sub-requirements (b) and (c) cannot be satisfied.
gaps: No pre-deployment testing records or staging approval artifacts available (needed for SI-2.r4(b))
No documented flaw identification/reporting process or ticketing system evidence (needed for SI-2.r4(a))
No organization-defined time-period SLA for update installation (needed for SI-2.r4(c))
No model registry entry for the 2026-03-15 hotfix — human attestation needed to determine whether an out-of-band approval existed
No evidence of whether the initial CreateEndpoint deployment at 11:00 on 2025-12-01 was intentionally sequenced after the 09:00 registry approval or whether the change-control gate was bypassed

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
